scope.boundary: This inventory describes only the supplied HTML style blocks. It does not prove a product-wide design system, runtime theme coverage, rendered contrast, component ownership, adoption, or cross-repository usage.

repeated_raw_candidates.boundary: Frequency is migration evidence, not proof that every repeated value deserves a token. Consolidate only values with shared semantic intent.

evidence_boundaries.literal: A raw literal is source-confirmed. It is not automatically a defect or a new semantic-token candidate.
evidence_boundaries.token_name: A custom-property name suggests intent but does not prove role-correct usage, theming, governance, documentation, or adoption.
evidence_boundaries.contrast: Color values alone do not prove rendered foreground/background pairs or contrast. Measure exact rendered pairs in each state and appearance.
evidence_boundaries.component: Selectors and repeated declarations suggest component boundaries but do not prove a reusable component API or shared implementation.
evidence_boundaries.visual: Source inventory cannot establish optical quality, state distinction, interaction behavior, or cross-viewport appearance without renders.
